series.title: Sewage Disposal Plant Operating
series.statusStatement: Active (EMST OPM series register, as of 2026-10-23).
series.group: Federal Wage System 5400 Industrial Equipment Operation
series.educationNote: from EMST's series record; not yet checked against the OPM qualification standard, so confirm with the HR office

generalCompetencies: not mapped in this release (X9 USA Hire and FWCI parts not built; WP-09 open item 6)

roles.functionStatement: Operate treatment processes in responsible charge so that delivered water and discharged effluent meet their limits.

x4.reviewStatus: unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person)

shown.label: Drinking water treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV / Class A-D, state-specific)

bands.indicativeBand: WG grade set by the federal wage system job grading standard (entry/journey/senior/lead)

majorDuties.duty: Operate drinking water treatment processes to meet water quality targets

tasks.statement: Adjust coagulant dosing from jar test results when raw-water turbidity, temperature or organic content changes
Verify disinfection contact time against required inactivation values at each operating flow and correct shortfalls before water enters distribution
Respond to a treatment upset by isolating the affected process unit, bringing backup treatment online and notifying the primacy agency
Supervise automated process-control loops, overriding setpoints when analyzer readings conflict with bench tests or visual plant checks

majorDuties.duty: Operate wastewater treatment and resource-recovery processes to permit limits

tasks.statement: Adjust aeration and sludge wasting rates using solids inventory, settleability and dissolved-oxygen trends to hold effluent within permit limits
Diagnose a biological process upset from microscopic examination, foam, odor and settling behavior before laboratory results confirm it
Route peak wet-weather flows through the plant to protect biological treatment, recording any bypass or overflow for required reporting
Operate anaerobic digestion and solids handling to meet biosolids pathogen-reduction and stability requirements while recovering digester gas

majorDuties.duty: Practice within licensure scope and responsible charge

tasks.statement: Determine whether an assigned task falls within the scope of one's licence or certification, referring out-of-scope work to a qualified professional
Exercise responsible charge over subordinates' professional work, directing and reviewing it so that the sealing professional can attest to it

majorDuties.duty: Supervise automated and AI-assisted process control in environmental operations

tasks.statement: Run a treatment process in safe manual operation when automation or communications fail, adapting the manual operating procedure to conditions
Monitor automated control loops and alarms on a treatment process, checking automated responses against field observations of process condition
Override an automated control action when process indicators show it is driving the system toward a permit or safety limit, documenting the decision

majorDuties.duty: Manage field sample custody and field quality control

tasks.statement: Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them
Report field conditions that invalidate samples, such as broken seals, temperature excursions or holding-time breaches, before results are used

majorDuties.duty: Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites

tasks.statement: Identify signs of potential hazardous materials at a field site, such as drums, stained soil, odours or unusual debris, before disturbing them
Isolate an incidentally discovered hazardous material, establishing a safe distance and notifying the designated responder before any further work
Wear the personal protective equipment the site health and safety plan specifies, checking its fit and function before entering the exclusion zone

majorDuties.duty: Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities

tasks.statement: Maintain an inventory of connected control and monitoring assets with their network zone, remote-access paths and owner.
Run an incident-response drill that switches a plant or monitoring network to manual operation, recording the time to a safe state and the gaps found.
Review remote access to control and monitoring systems under the change procedure, removing access that is no longer needed.

majorDuties.duty: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings

tasks.statement: Conduct a no-blame review of a near miss or incident with the people involved to identify contributing conditions and corrective actions
Deliver a pre-work safety briefing that covers site hazards, controls, communications and the stop-work procedure for the assigned work area
Design a unit learning-from-incidents process that links reporting channels, review triggers and pre-work briefing content

majorDuties.duty: Manage a municipal stormwater programme to meet permit conditions

tasks.statement: Inspect catch basins, pipes and outfalls on a scheduled route, recording each structure that restricts flow for cleaning
Trace an illicit discharge from a dry-weather outfall flow to its source using field screening and system maps

bands.pctTimeNotice: % time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.

knowledgeStatements: Stop-work authority lets any worker halt a task they judge unsafe; the task resumes only after the hazard is assessed and the plan revised, and the person who stopped it is not penalized.
A no-blame incident review separates system and condition causes from individual error and sanctions only reckless or wilful acts, so that people keep reporting near misses.
